briefTitle: LOTUS-CC: An Observational Research Study to Uncover Subtypes of Cancer Cachexia

typedChecks.sourceText: Have a primary diagnosis of unresectable or stage IV 1) non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), 2) pancreatic adenocarcinoma, or 3) colorectal cancer
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Have a primary diagnosis of unresectable or stage IV 1) non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), 2) pancreatic adenocarcinoma, or 3) colorectal cancer

typedChecks.sourceText: Have an Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of 0, 1 or 2
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Have an Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of 0, 1 or 2

typedChecks.sourceText: Be 18 years of age or older
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Be 18 years of age or older

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Plan to start first-line systemic anti-cancer therapy (chemotherapy, immunotherapy, targeted therapy, interventional clinical trial) in the next 6 weeks or has started first-line systemic therapy in the previous 6 weeks.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior and concurrent therapy windows and maintenance exclusions are complex and cannot be expressed as a simple typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Be able to understand, speak and read English
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Language ability is not a standard typed clinical trial eligibility criterion.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have contraindications to physical function assessments (30-second arm curl, Timed-Up-And-Go test, or 30-second chair-stand test) per the treating provider or their designee
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Contraindications to physical function assessments depend on investigator judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have any planned major surgeries within the next 3 months
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Planned major surgery is a subjective future event exclusion.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have received chemotherapy or surgery for separate primary cancer within the past 3 years other than early local staged non-melanoma skin cancer
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior separate primary cancer history is a complex clinical history rule not covered by simple typed checks.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Be pregnant
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Pregnancy is not represented by an allowed typed kind.
